messages:
alex: Hey team — Zenith CSM reached out, they want to run a 3-week pilot that uses our Dedicated + hosted fallback. Need a short runbook so their infra / sales ops can sign off. Can we align on deliverables and the pricing asks?

maria: +1. Do we have bandwidth for a dedicated pool starting week of Apr 12? (they want low-latency demo for their web product)

devon: We can reserve 2x v100-equivalent GPUs for the pilot. Need final model selection and sequence length profile. Approx QPS?

zenith_csm: Zenith here — target is ~20 qps at 512 tokens for the demo peak, 5 qps baseline. We prefer Llama-2-70B quantized if that's supported. Also need SSO + SCQA answers for legal.

sarah: We support quantized 70B variants on Dedicated. Tradeoffs: latency vs cost. I'll add latency targets to the runbook.

alex: Action items: (1) runbook draft (2) pricing sketch for pilot (3) security questionnaire owner (4) onboarding steps + sample infra rules. Who owns each?

maria: I can draft the onboarding steps and the schedule cadence with Zenith (weekly checkpoints + go/no-go).

devon: I'll do the runbook + model config (including fallback routing to hosted smaller model). Will put sample batch settings.

jordan: I'll handle pricing sketch — need to confirm whether we give a pilot discount or offset against a committed Dedicated uplift. What are acceptable guardrails?

alex: For security Qs, @sarah you ok to coordinate answers to their questionnaire? They sent a 40‑question doc yesterday.

sarah: Yep — I already started. A few potential escalations: (a) they want customer-managed keys (HSM) for logs — that's an enterprise-only option for Private, not for Hosted. (b) they want IP allowlist for ingest endpoints — easy for Dedicated. I'll mark which questions need legal/security sign-off.

zenith_csm: Noted. For pilot we can accept Redwood-managed keys, but we need documented retention and access controls. Also: can we get a simple network snippet for our infra team to open ports?

devon: Network snippet:```
Allowed outbound: 443 to api.redwood-inference.com
Allowed outbound: 10250-10260 to dedicated-host-ip-range (for control plane)
Optional inbound for demo hooks: 443 from Zenith public IPs
```

devon: Also adding the routing policy we'll use: primary Dedicated pool -> fallback hosted smol-13B -> circuit-breaker to queue requests if latency spikes.

jordan: Pricing sketch options: (A) free pilot with credits up to $5k + standard usage, (B) discounted pilot rate (50%) with a $10k refundable commitment that converts to reserved capacity if they sign 12mo. Thoughts?

maria: Zenith prefers B historically; gives them skin in the game. Ask finance for approval but present both.

alex: Can someone add a simple timeline to the runbook: kickoff call, infra whitelisting, data/sample prompts, demo dry-run, speedrun for exec demo? I can host kickoff Mon 9am PT if that works.

sarah: I'll upload initial SecQA answers to the shared drive by EOD today and flag the 6 questions that need legal.

devon: Draft runbook pushed: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/zenith-pilot (please review). Key sections: objectives, success criteria (latency < 200ms P50, 95% availability during demo windows), rollback plan.

zenith_csm: Thanks — we'll review and send sample prompts. Also can you list required contacts (SRE, CSM, sales) in the runbook?

maria: I'll add the contact list + meeting invites.

alex: Great. Next steps: jordan to ping finance, sarah to finish SecQA flags, devon to finalize runbook + network snippet, maria to schedule kickoff. We'll reconvene after kickoff. @zenith_csm any preferred kickoff window besides Mon 9am PT?

zenith_csm: Mon 9am PT works for our EMEA and US teams. Looking forward. :rocket:

jordan: I'll loop in finance now. If anyone needs a pricing mock for the deck, shout — I can do a 1-slide estimate.

security-bot: Reminder: please do not paste full PII in the thread. Use the secure questionnaire document for sensitive items.

alex: Thanks all — I'll post the kickoff invite and preliminary agenda shortly. :thumbsup:
